calls.video_title: Why These 5 Stocks Are Crashing (But I'm Buying More)
calls.thesis: First tracked. TransMedics (caption garbles as 'Transmetics') is in the Asymmetric portfolio: 91.5% 5-year revenue CAGR and 56% 3-year CAGR, just a $3.6B market cap, expanding from the US into Europe and through the regulatory process for more organs in more countries. 'The kind of company that I just want to own for the next decade or two' — own the companies building the future you want to see.
calls.base: Regulatory expansion in Europe keeps the compounding going.
calls.bull: More organs and more countries multiply the addressable market.
